$comment: Visual subjects for the 57 item icons (what the object LOOKS like; the content record says what it does). build_item_prompts.py turns these into manifest prompts. Materials of the Vale only: stone, glass, carved wood, cloth, felt, leather, resin, matte blued steel; no gold, gems, runes or polished metal.
notched_blade: a short sword with a notched pale chalk-stone blade and a leather-wrapped wooden hilt
reading_lens: a round reading lens of pale blue-tinted glass in a carved walnut frame with a small cloth tassel
ironstone_guard: a small round shield of banded dark-orange ironstone with a felt-padded rim
grove_sickle: a curved sickle with a pale stone blade and a vine-wrapped ash-wood handle, a sprig of fan-shaped leaves tied to it
sap_flask: a stoppered round glass flask of glowing green sap with a cord knotted around its neck
spare_lamp: a small hooded lantern of carved dark wood and frosted glass with a warm amber flame inside
noon_tonic: a tall slender stoppered bottle of pale cream-white liquid catching bright sunlight, sealed with wax
chalk_knife: a plain knife with a pale chalk-stone blade and a cloth-wrapped grip
glass_lens: a single clear convex glass lens gathering a bright point of light at its centre
ochre_brick: a single block of warm ochre sandstone with chiselled edges
felt_vest: a thick quilted felt vest in muted slate blue, neatly folded
linen_wrap: a rolled bundle of pale linen cloth bound with brown cord
taut_cord: a coiled bowstring of waxed cord pulled taut between two carved wooden pegs
hand_bell: a small hand bell of frosted pale-blue glass with a carved wooden handle
lamp_oil: a squat carved stone jar brimming with glowing amber lamp oil, a wick resting on its lip
whetted_knife: a keen dagger with a matte blued-steel blade and a leather grip, resting on a grey whetstone
banded_club: a heavy wooden club bound with dark ironstone bands
glint_sling: a leather sling whirling, a glinting pale stone in its pouch
bellglass: a bell-shaped glass vessel holding a small swirl of soft violet light
burning_glass: a thick round burning glass focusing a sharp beam of sunlight into a white-hot point
felt_coat: a heavy layered felt coat with a high collar in warm grey
linen_hood: a linen hood folded flat into a neat square bundle like pressed laundry, lying on a small wooden board and seen from above at three-quarter angle: the hood's smooth rounded crown is folded down flat on top of the bundle, a turned hem shows a strip of darker oat lining and a neat running hem stitch, a short cord tied round the bundle; warm oat and soft grey-beige cloth, never pure white; nothing stands up, no opening, no hollow, no head form, no stand shaped like a head
ironstone_mantle: a broad shoulder mantle of carved dark-orange ironstone plates over draped grey felt
warning_bell: a heavy carved stone bell hung from a wooden yoke, faint rings of sound rippling around it
dialcutter: a broad single-edged blade of honed grey stone with one straight engraved line along it and a cloth-wrapped grip
shadecut: a slim dark blade of violet-black stone trailing a wisp of ink-like shadow
splitlight_bow: an elegant recurve bow of pale ash wood with a clear glass grip, a ray of light splitting into three beside it
focal_lens: three nested glass lenses aligned in a carved wooden frame, focusing one bright beam
inkglass_rod: a slender wand of dark ink-violet glass with a pale carved stone cap
kindly_lamp: a gentle hanging lantern of warm amber resin panels glowing softly, hung from a carved wooden hook
sunstring: a masterwork bow of pale carved wood and clear glass whose string is a thread of bright sunlight
noonglass: a palm-sized disc of clear glass holding a small captured white sun at its centre, set in a carved stone ring
seatstone: a heavy round base-stone with a carved rim and a deep socket at its centre, glowing faintly cream-white
hourcleaver: a great two-handed cleaver of honed chalk stone with one engraved straight line, leather-wrapped haft, a faint warm glow along its edge
shelter_lamp: an ornate lantern of carved ironstone and amber resin panels casting a soft dome of warm protective light
road_sandals: a pair of simple leather road sandals with cord laces
dust_runners: a pair of light running boots of wrapped leather kicking up a trail of pale dust
felt_treads: a pair of sturdy grey felt-lined boots with thick layered soles
chalk_slippers: a pair of soft pale slippers dusted with chalk, trailing a faint violet shimmer
lampblack_edge: a slim single-edged knife of pale matte blued steel with one thin matte band of black lamp soot along its spine, a grip wrapped in pale grey cord, the blade clean and dry with no smoke
lampblack_coat: a long soot-dark felt greatcoat with a broad turned-down collar and a warm grey lining showing at the cuffs, a drifting cloud of black soot trailing from its hem
lampblack_lens: a round hand lens of smoked glass on a short carved wooden handle, the glass clouded black with soot at its rim and clear at its centre where a pale beam passes, a wisp of black smoke curling off it
quarry_pick: a heavy quarryman's pick with a long pointed head of matte blued steel on a stout ash-wood haft, chips of pale stone flying from its point
deepglass_rod: a short heavy rod of smooth thick deep-blue glass, darkest at its core like still deep water, its grip wrapped in pale cord and capped with carved pale stone; smooth and rounded, not faceted
glass_veil: a curtain of thin curved panes of frosted pale-violet glass hanging on fine threads from a carved wooden bar, like a still wind chime, soft light caught in the panes
glintmail: a short shirt of small overlapping pale stone scales sewn onto dark leather, laid out flat, a bright glint of light flashing off one shoulder scale
dawnspur: a pale tan leather bracer laced with cord, one short straight spur-spike of matte blued steel jutting forward from its wrist, a bright streak of pale dawn light flaring from the spike's point
resin_maul: a heavy two-handed maul on a stout wooden haft whose head is a smooth rounded lump of warm cloudy honey-amber tree resin, soft and pebble-like with no flat faces or facets, bound with two dark ironstone bands, a slow drop of golden sap welling from its underside
shadowpin: a long slim throwing spike of pale carved stone standing point-first in a small round flagstone of pale grey stone, its long crisp violet shadow cast across the flagstone and pinned beneath its point, dry stone with no liquid
bellrope: a thick coiled bell rope of braided pale hemp ending in a heavy knotted tassel, a small frosted-glass bell tied at its end, faint rings of sound around it
almslamp: a small shallow oil lamp of pale glazed clay set in an open carved wooden bowl, a warm amber flame, little drops of light falling into the bowl
callstone: a heavy curved war horn carved from banded dark-orange ironstone with a wide flared mouth, rings of sound bursting out of it
hourstring: a crossbow of pale carved ash wood with clear glass limbs, a bolt of bright white light loaded on it, its taut string glowing
needlefall: a long slender needle-thin sword of pale chalk stone plunging point-down, a streak of light trailing behind it like a falling star
stillhour: a tall tower shield of pale carved stone planted upright in the ground, a thin line of still white light along its carved rim, specks of dust hanging motionless in the air around it
afterlight: a short slender magic wand of clear glass with a small rounded glowing tip and a pale carved stone handle, held at a slant, two fading violet-white afterimages of the wand trailing beside it; a wand with a rounded tip, not a blade, no sharp edge
watchbell: a large bell of frosted pale glass hanging from a curved arm of carved dark wood, a warm amber flame burning inside the bell, soft rings of light spreading outward from it
